name: Ember-Rift
description: Ember-Rift is a world of canyons so deep they hold the day's heat like cupped hands, their walls striped in oxidized crimson and black volcanic glass. At the bottom of the greatest chasms, geothermal springs feed shallow mineral pools where steam rises through the thin amber sky. In these sheltered depths, forests of heat-tolerant frond-trees spread in silver-red tiers, their sap glinting like cooling metal.

Walking the rift floors feels strangely gentle for a volcanic world. The thin atmosphere carries sound poorly, so the canyons are hushed except for the trickle of hot springs and the soft rustle of fronds in the feeble wind. Nights are cold enough to frost the upper rims while the depths stay warm and faintly luminous, the flora dimming and brightening in slow waves that researchers have never fully explained.

The crystal caverns threading the canyon walls took millions of years to grow, and some chambers hold formations taller than ships. A small xenobotanical outpost clings to the rim of the Verdan Deep, its crew cataloguing compounds in the local flora that accelerate tissue repair beyond anything synthesized. Old survey notes hint that the caverns were mapped once before, by someone who left no name and took no credit.

Pharmaceutical guilds would pay fortunes for licensed harvest rights, and the outpost's researchers fear what a full-scale extraction economy would do to an ecosystem that exists nowhere else. Tensions are rising as charter ships begin arriving without permits. The frond-forests survived a world that tried to burn them; whether they survive profit is another question.
